# Zig Zag

*Joins swing highs and lows that reverse by more than a set percentage.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** on the price pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Zig Zag** under **Support & resistance**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Price deviation for reversals (%) | float | `5` |
| Show price labels | bool | `true` |
| Line color | color | `"#2962FF"` |
| Line width | int | `2` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/zigzag.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Zig Zag", shortTitle: "ZigZag", overlay: true });
const deviation = input.float("Price deviation for reversals (%)", 5, { min: 0.01, step: 0.5 });
const showLabels = input.bool("Show price labels", true);
const color = input.color("Line color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" });
const width = input.int("Line width", 2, { min: 1, max: 4 });
/** @param {number} p */
const fmt = (p) => { const d = p > 0 ? math.max(2, 4 - math.floor(math.log(p) / math.log(10))) : 2; return String(math.round(p, d)); };
let dir = 0, anchorT = NaN, anchorP = NaN, extT = NaN, extP = NaN, line = 0, prevPivot = NaN;
event.onCandle((bar) => {
  if (dir === 0) {
    anchorT = extT = bar.time; anchorP = bar.low; extP = bar.high; dir = 1;
    line = draw.line({ x1: anchorT, y1: anchorP, x2: extT, y2: extP, color, width });
    return;
  }
  if (dir === 1 ? bar.high >= extP : bar.low <= extP) {
    extT = bar.time; extP = dir === 1 ? bar.high : bar.low;
    draw.set(line, { x2: extT, y2: extP });
    return;
  }
  const back = dir === 1 ? bar.low : bar.high;
  if (math.abs(back - extP) / extP * 100 < deviation) return;
  if (showLabels) {
    const pct = prevPivot === prevPivot ? ((extP - prevPivot) / prevPivot) * 100 : NaN;
    draw.label({ x: extT, y: extP, text: pct === pct ? `${fmt(extP)} (${pct >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${math.round(pct, 2)}%)` : fmt(extP),
                 style: dir === 1 ? "down" : "up", color: "rgba(0,0,0,0)", textColor: color, size: "small" });
  }
  prevPivot = extP;
  anchorT = extT; anchorP = extP; dir = -dir; extT = bar.time; extP = back;
  line = draw.line({ x1: anchorT, y1: anchorP, x2: extT, y2: extP, color, width });
});
```
